card.name: Author names in reference lists
card.fires_on: Initials, commas and the start of surnames inside lists of authors in citations, especially after a run of 'Surname AB,' entries. Also fires on first names or surnames of doctors being credited.

modes.label: Author list punctuation
modes.description: Commas or periods between authors in a citation, right before the next author's name.
modes.example: Cunningham FG, Gilstrap LC, Gant NF<<,>> Hauth JC, Leveno K

modes.label: Start of a surname
modes.description: The first letter of an author's surname or name after a comma or first name.
modes.example: Cunningham FG, Gilstrap LC, Gant NF,<< H>>auth JC, Leveno KJ

modes.label: Named doctor credits
modes.description: Part of a physician's name in a byline or advice column.
modes.example: DR. RONALD<< P>>ETERSEN ADVISES: A Your

card.plain: It lights up inside the author names of a reference list, between or within names.
